subject: POC availability + load-test cadence confirmation
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@nimbushealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC dates — quick availability check

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the demo today. Daniel and I discussed and we think a 90-minute hands-on session + a separate 2-hour load window would be ideal so our infra team can observe throughput. 

Current constraints: our security review completes 5/20, so any deep load testing before that needs to be on a controlled sandbox. Can you outline the minimum capacity you need for the first pass (GPU count / qps)? Also let us know a couple of 90-minute slots the week of 5/24 for the prompt review and routing decision.

— Claire
Director, Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@nimbushealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC dates — quick availability check

Claire — great to hear, glad the demo was useful. Proposed plan below (high level). Please confirm which week works and any restrictions for sandbox vs. production-like traffic: 

1) Week-of 5/24: 90-minute hands-on session (prompt review, routing rules, KV/prefix caching demo). Goal: align on expected prompt patterns and routing fallbacks.
2) Week-of 6/7: 2-hour load window (throughput baseline + latency SLO measurements). Goal: reach your target QPS and validate tail latency with our runbook.

Minimum sandbox footprint for initial load window: 4x A10G-equivalent GPUs (continuous batching configured) — expected steady-state throughput ~120 QPS for 512-token median response; we will tune batching to meet latency SLOs. If you prefer a lower-capacity smoke test first, we can start with 2 GPUs and scale.

Suggested 90-minute slots (PST):
- Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2027-05-26 14:00–15:30

Action items:
- Claire: confirm preferred 90-minute slot and whether the sandbox limits are acceptable.
- Nimbus infra: confirm any port/IP allowlists for the runbook.
- Monica / Rishi: I'll share the draft runbook and harness config for review.

Attachments: redwood_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (draft), load_harness_config_v2.yaml (sample)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Rishi will own the load harness and telemetry mapping; he'll need access to Nimbus's trace/span labels (or we can map on our side).

- Aditya: I'll rehearse the prompt set and provide a pared-down list for the 90-minute session (no PII).

We'll be ready to push the runbook by EOD 5/11.

— Monica
Product Ops | Redwood Inference

Thanks — Tue 5/25 10:00–11:30 works for the hands-on session. For the load window, our infra prefers the week of 6/7; 6/9 13:00–15:00 ET would be our preferred slot if that aligns with your ops. 

Sandbox constraints: we can provision up to 4 GPUs in the sandbox but need a signed test policy (simple one-page) confirming data retention and log handling. Can you send a stub? Also, our security team will provide allowlist IPs by 5/21.

I'll accept the draft runbook and harness config for review — please share links.

— Claire

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@nimbushealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC dates — confirmation + runbook link

Fantastic — locking the slots now. Calendar invites sent for:
- Hands-on prompt review: Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–11:30 PDT (90m)
- Load window: Wed 2027-06-09 10:00–12:00 PDT (2h) — corresponds to 13:00–15:00 ET per Claire

Materials shared: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-redwood-nimbus-runbook (redwood_poc_runbook_v1.pdf attached in the invite), and sample harness config at the same folder (load_harness_config_v2.yaml).

Stub test policy for sandbox attached: redwood_sandbox_test_policy.docx (one-page, data-handling commitments). Please confirm once your security team signs off — we'll only start the heavy load after the signed policy is uploaded to the Drive link.

Runbook highlights (summary):
- Pre-run checklist: allowlist, API key scoping, retention window -> 7 days for all request/response logs in sandbox.
- Load profile: ramp to 120 QPS over 10 minutes, sustain 20 minutes, then spike to 180 QPS for 5 minutes.
- Latency SLO targets: p95 < 450ms, p99 < 900ms for the 512-token median prompt set.
- Fallback policy: automatic model downgrade + 2-second client-facing message if p99 > 2s.

Next steps: Nimbus to upload signed sandbox policy and allowlist; Rishi will send the telemetry mapping request by 5/18.

Thanks everyone — see the invites.

Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment references: redwood_poc_runbook_v1.pdf, load_harness_config_v2.yaml, redwood_sandbox_test_policy.docx
